headline: Chiefs place LT Josh Simmons on IR as rehab process stalls
summary: The Chiefs have placed left tackle Josh Simmons on injured reserve, further delaying his return from a bulging disk in his lower back.

headline: Lamar Jackson present, participating at start of Thursday practice
summary: It looks like Lamar Jackson is on track to return from his ankle injury this weekend when the Ravens play the Bengals.

headline: Seahawks RB Zach Charbonnet activated off PUP list
summary: Seahawks RB Zach Charbonnet, who has yet to play this season after scoring 12 TDs in 2025, has been activated off the PUP list and added to the 53-man roster.

headline: Baker Mayfield: Thumb is in a place where it’s strong enough to be able to play
summary: Buccaneers quarterback Baker Mayfield appears on track to return from a dislocated right thumb in Week 7 when Tampa Bay plays Carolina.

headline: Jordan Love dealing with sore back, but expects to play vs. Lions
summary: Packers quarterback Jordan Love popped up on Wednesday's injury report as limited with a back injury.

headline: JJ Watt lands new deal as full-time CBS lead analyst replacement for Tony Romo
summary: J.J. Watt will be the full-time lead NFL game analyst for CBS Sports, filling the role previously held by Tony Romo.
